pipeline_name: Pump Station 06- Qassim PS Gas Pipeline

resolutions.researcher_notes: Two independent project pages describe this exact line (226 km, 46-inch, Pump Station 06 near Riyadh to Qassim Power Plant, East-West Qassim Gas Pipeline 1) as built and finished. DMS Projects lists Project Status = Completed; the EPC contractor LAIC/Lamar states 'Awarded in 2015, Completed in 2018'. A completed gas trunk delivering to the Qassim power plant supports Status = operating. Both are independent of GEM and each other (project-tracking DB vs contractor's own project page).

CONTRADICTION FLAG: no source supports StartYear1 = 2021. The EPC contractor page (LAIC/Lamar) states the pipeline was 'Awarded in 2015, Completed in 2018' ('Completed between 2015 and 2018'); DMS Projects frames the parent MGSE program as targeting 12.5 BSCFD by 2020. Both point to in-service circa 2018, not 2021. The 2021 start year appears incorrect and should be reviewed (likely ~2018). Marked UNRESOLVED because no verifiable source corroborates 2021.

METenders project page states verbatim: 'Package 2: Central region pipeline. Scope includes the construction of 226 kilometers of 46" pipeline on the East West Qassim Gas Pipeline 1. Estimated budget is almost $364 million.' Directly supports SegmentCost = 364,000,000 USD. Single-source (medium). Note a discrepancy: the EPC contractor LAIC/Lamar lists its own contract Value as USD 220.38 million — that is the EPC award, narrower than the ~$364M package budget cited by GEM; not a conflict on the figure GEM chose, but worth noting. (The brief flagged this URL DEAD_LINK; it is in fact live/HTTP 200 — liveness false-negative.)

Both sources identify Saudi Aramco as the owner/client of the MGSE Phase 2 Package 2 Central Region Pipeline. DMS Projects lists Owner/Client = Saudi Aramco; METenders describes the Master Gas System Expansion as an Aramco program (the Master Gas System is wholly Aramco-owned). Supports Owner1 = Aramco, 100%. Two independent sources.
